hooks.command: node -e "const data = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf-8')); const path = data?.tool_input?.file_path || ''; if (path.includes('.env') || path.includes('secrets')) { console.error('❌ Blocked: Never edit secrets files'); process.exit(2); }"
hooks.description: Block editing of .env and secrets files

hooks.command: node -e "const data = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf-8')); const cmd = data?.tool_input?.command || ''; if (/\.env|secrets/.test(cmd) && /echo|cat|>>|>/.test(cmd)) { console.error('❌ Blocked: Never write to secrets files via Bash'); process.exit(2); }"
hooks.description: Block Bash commands that write to .env or secrets files
